description: Create a new timeline section. Name is required, max 45 characters (Vibo's limit, checked before anything is sent). Place it with afterSectionId (directly after that section) or position (0-based index; 0 = first); with neither it goes at the end of the timeline, like the web app. visibility "host" (default) = "Me and DJ", "public" = visible to guests too. Vibo gives a section a host creates "hosts can order songs" = off, which only the DJ can turn on. Returns the new section _id. Asks the user to confirm first: a confirmation prompt where the client supports one; otherwise the first call returns a preview and a confirmToken, and only a repeat call with that token proceeds (see MCP_CONFIRM_MODE).

afterSectionId.description: Put the new section directly after this section _id.

confirmToken.description: ONLY for the two-step confirmation fallback (a client without MCP elicitation). The confirmToken from this same tool's phase-1 "confirmation-required" response, passed back ONLY after the user has seen that preview and explicitly approved it in chat — never on the first call, never invented, never reused. Call again with the same arguments. Ignored when the client supports elicitation.

note.description: Note to the DJ (set right after creating, via updateSection).

position.description: 0-based timeline index for the new section; past the end appends. Use instead of afterSectionId.

time.description: Scheduled time as "hh:mm am/pm", e.g. "05:30 pm".

visibility.description: "host" (default) = Me and DJ only; "public" = guests can see it too.

name: vibo_create_section
